infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AGAP needs your location to report your emergency accurately.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: AGAP uses your location in the background for responder tracking.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AGAP uses the camera to capture evidence at the incident scene.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AGAP needs photo library access to attach images to incidents.
